scope: Exact source evidence production fix and local real Standard acceptance; no VPS deployment.

cause: The model-authored entry code omitted the eight-space indentation already in its draft tool arguments.
The model-authored README code contained only the first sentence of a longer source line.
SDK native artifacts retained those draft strings; the Axiom source verifier correctly rejected them.
Axiom scan instructions prohibited per-line slicing and did not specify complete-line preservation.

fix.producer: Read-only source-evidence extract/check helper staged in each execution outside the source snapshot.
fix.exactExtraction: Returns complete lines with original indentation and spaces, explicit start/end lines and source file hash.
fix.preSubmissionCheck: The model checks the same saved draft object before submitting it to SDK; checker fails nonzero and never rewrites evidence or source.
fix.guidance: Require exact full source lines; explanations stay in explanation; preserve SDK artifact schema.

regressions: Prior dedented and sentence-only excerpts fail both producer and Server checks.
Changed tokens, incorrect line ranges, unsafe paths, symlinks and oversized source remain rejected.
Checker leaves input draft bytes unchanged.

limitations: The real model chose two Python code evidence entries; it did not submit the README sentence as code evidence in this run. README full-line extraction and sentence rejection were validated by isolated regressions.
Source matches confirm quotation identity, not dynamic exploit reproduction.
Native retries remain permitted; this run did not inject a disconnect to exercise them.
No separate independent-validation operation or VPS deployment was performed.
Cost remains unknown; existing unit prices and fee history were not changed.
